description: Build stable AI visibility prompt sets mapped to owned assets, platforms, competitors, citations, and weekly action routing. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

audience.description: Intended reader or buyer group in plain language; do not include unnecessary personal data. Type: String. Maximum: 180 characters. Optional; no client default.

cadence.description: Recommended comparison frequency for the prompt set; does not schedule or execute recurring checks. Type: String. Accepted values: "weekly", "biweekly", "monthly". Default: "weekly".

category.description: Product or market category used to construct relevant AI-visibility prompts. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 160 characters. Required.

competitors.description: Competing brands or domains to compare using the data supplied to this workflow. Type: Array. Maximum: 20 items. Default: [].

items.description: One competing brand or domain name used in the comparison. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 160 characters. Required.

include_citation_checks.description: Include citation-check prompt variants in the plan when true; does not execute those checks. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

include_competitor_checks.description: Include competitor-comparison prompt variants in the plan when true. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

locale.description: Human-readable market or locale context for the prompt set, for example United States. Type: String. Minimum: 2 characters. Maximum: 80 characters. Default: "United States".

owned_assets.description: Supplied pages or resources you own that can support prompts or backlink recommendations; this does not edit or publish them. Type: Array. Maximum: 100 items. Default: [].

items.description: One page or resource you own, supplied as evidence for the plan. Type: Object. Required.

page_type.description: Page format or classification for this record; select one of the accepted values. Type: String. Accepted values: "homepage", "docs", "blog_post", "comparison", "pricing", "product", "case_study", "tool", "other". Default: "other".

title.description: Title of the supplied page or work item, used as its human-readable label. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 180 characters. Required.

topics.description: Relevant topics or themes associated with this target, page or prospect. Type: Array. Maximum: 20 items. Default: [].

items.description: One topic or theme relevant to the supplied entity. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 120 characters. Required.

url.description: Absolute URL of your supplied owned asset to associate with planned prompts; no page fetch is performed. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Required.

personas.description: Audience-role labels to vary the planned prompts by buyer context. Type: Array. Maximum: 20 items. Default: [].

items.description: One audience-role label used to vary prompt context. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 120 characters. Required.

platforms.description: AI/search platforms to design prompts for; this plans prompts and does not run them on those platforms. Type: Array. Minimum: 1 items. Maximum: 6 items. Default: ["chatgpt","perplexity","google_ai"].

items.description: One AI/search platform to design prompts for; no platform request is executed. Type: String. Accepted values: "chatgpt", "perplexity", "google_ai", "gemini", "copilot", "claude". Required.

product_terms.description: Product names or product-category phrases to incorporate into the planned prompts. Type: Array. Maximum: 40 items. Default: [].

items.description: One product or product-category phrase to include in prompt planning. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 120 characters. Required.

prompt_count.description: Maximum number of prompts to generate in the planned set, not the number of live AI requests. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 6. Maximum: 50. Default: 20.

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Your target brand, domain or URL used to scope this workflow; supply the entity you want assessed. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.

topics.description: Relevant topics or themes associated with this target, page or prospect. Type: Array. Minimum: 1 items. Maximum: 40 items. Required.

items.description: One topic or theme relevant to the supplied entity. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 120 characters. Required.

name: agentseo_ai_visibility_prompt_set
